headline: Xero Shares Turn A Corner: 39% Gain In Six Weeks Brings Warning Sign - The Bull
summary: Xero shares added 8.75% last week, extending their rebound to 39% over six weeks, after strong interim results and a raised full-year outlook.
why: Xero is a cloud-based accounting software company listed on the ASX and headquartered in Wellington, New Zealand. Its results and guidance are closely watched by investors in small-business software.

source.name: The Bull - Independent analysis and news on the global stock markets.
